_note: Indicative UK supplier directory for the low-carbon material palette. Each supplier lists the material classes it can provide so the BOM can be matched to real sources for quotation.

suppliers.name: Haddonstone
suppliers.blurb: UK's leading architectural cast stone manufacturer — columns, capitals, balustrades, facade panels.

suppliers.name: Procter Cast Stone
suppliers.blurb: Bespoke reconstructed-stone cast units, marble-dust mixes, bush-hammered and honed finishes.

suppliers.name: Hanson / Regen GGBS
suppliers.blurb: Ground granulated blast-furnace slag (GGBS) — the low-carbon binder for cast stone and geopolymer mixes.

suppliers.name: Salisbury Stone & Aggregates
suppliers.blurb: Fine-milled marble dust filler for the cast-stone substrate mix — a calcium-carbonate by-product of dimension-stone sawing.

suppliers.name: Hanson Cement
suppliers.blurb: Portland cement (CEM I) — the primary hydraulic binder topping up the GGBS/marble-dust substrate mix.

suppliers.name: Winn & Coales (Geopolymer)
suppliers.blurb: Alkali-activated fly-ash / slag geopolymer binders for cores, slabs and foundation pads.

suppliers.name: Pilkington UK
suppliers.blurb: Double / triple glazed units and electrochromic smart glass for the window schedule.

suppliers.name: Saint-Gobain Glass
suppliers.blurb: Low-carbon flat glass and sealed insulating glass units with EPD documentation.

suppliers.name: Pipex / GRP Solutions
suppliers.blurb: Prefabricated GRP wet-zone pods and bathroom modules with cast-in services.

suppliers.name: Mateenbar UK
suppliers.blurb: Non-corroding basalt-fibre reinforcement bar and mesh for every cast-stone pour.
